interpretation: Cold q7169 preserves all 32 GB10 outputs and first logit, with three complete model checkpoints. Restored and independently recomputed 7168 prefixes both produce 220/9.3125 instead of the GB10 cold prompt token 82/9.25. All 186 captured operator/carrier/KV files in the two continuation routes are bitwise equal. This identifies a continuation arithmetic boundary shared by the old independent seed and new saved checkpoint route. FLA seeded-prefill versus decode recurrence is the next hypothesis; no causal proof is claimed yet.
